results.title: #SHOWBIZ: 'I overpacked her life': Awal Ashaari reflects on first-time fatherhood regret
results.description: KUALA LUMPUR: Popular TV host and actor Awal Ashaari has candidly reflected on his early parenting journey, admitting to making numerous mistakes while raising his eldest daughter, Lara Alana.
